Package sys.pro

Class MatrixGraph

java.lang.Object
sys.pro.MatrixGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
Graph
public class MatrixGraph extends Object implements Graph
Implementation of a directed graph using an adjacency matrix. This matrix dynamically expands when the number of vertices exceeds its capacity.
